No exchange platform; a register-to-register interconnection under one authorisation is not a platform.

facts.fact: The data protection authority issued deliberation 009/2025 under article 40 of law no. 2017-020 of 22 July 2017 on personal data protection.
The data protection authority met on 19 November 2025 under its named president with seven named members.
facts.system: Autorite de protection des donnees a caractere personnel

facts.fact: The deliberation cites decree no. 2022/13 of 18 February 2022 on the composition, organisation and functioning of the data protection authority.

In deliberation 009/2025 the authority gave a favourable opinion on the journalists' professional register of the media regulator HAPA on conditions, refusing to authorise collection of mother tongue as sensitive data.

MRT.note: A population register is only named as the one register the journalists' register may link to; its service is not stated.
No cross-border link or facility stated.
